# Harbor of Saltwind

## Overview
A sheltered harbor city on the southern coast. Merchants dominate the council.

## Geography
Rocky cliffs to the west; mudflats and eelgrass to the east.

## Climate
Wet winters, cool summers, frequent fog.

## History
Founded after the Salt Compact. Formerly called Windreach. Supersedes the older fishing village charter.

## Rules
No private warships may dock without a writ.

## Limits
The harbor cannot host more than forty deep-draft ships.

## Costs
Dock fees rise with draft and cargo value.

## Origin
Settled by salt traders from the inland lakes.

## Structure
Harbor Master, Merchants' Circle, and Wardens.

## Open questions
Who sank the first lighthouse? Leave blank — this is a protected mystery.

## PROPOSED: Trade pact
A draft pact with the inland leagues is not canon yet.

## Unmapped trivia
Local eel pies are famous at Midwinter.
